<thought>Based on the ESI‑MS spectrum, the most intense ion is at m/z 193.1103, which corresponds to a [M+H]⁺ ion. Subtracting the mass of a proton gives a neutral monoisotopic mass of ≈192.103 Da. The isotopic pattern (M+1 ≈12.5 %) indicates roughly 12 carbon atoms. The formula that best matches this mass and isotopic pattern is C₁₂H₁₆O₂ (exact monoisotopic mass 192.1150 Da, within typical instrument tolerance).</thought>
<final_answer>C12H16O2</final_answer>
